'''ST-149''', or '''ST 149''' was a [[Delta-class T-3c shuttle|''Delta''-class T-3c shuttle]] that was used as a [[transport]] for [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] and his [[death trooper]] unit.<ref name="DB" /> Krennic chose the [[Starship|ship]] due to his appreciation for its unusual geometry, although he held no sentimentality for the craft. [[Captain]] [[Dunstig Pterro]] held more affection for the ship, nicknaming it '''''Pteradon'''''.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />

==History==
===Capturing Galen Erso===
[[File:ST_149.png|thumb|left|180px|ST 149 in landing configuration]]
In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' places the capture of [[Galen Walton Erso]] to six [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[19 BBY]].</ref> the ship was used to transport [[Orson Callan Krennic]] and his [[death trooper]]s to [[Capture of Galen Erso|recruit Galen]] for [[Project Stardust]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Leaving the Death Star and going to Eadu===
Aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], Krennic had his own docking bay for his shuttle, adjacent to the [[Overbridge (Death Star I)|Overbridge]]. He used the shuttle to leave the [[Death Star]], to go to [[Eadu]] to meet with Galen at the [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] attacked the facility, Krennic evacuated in ST 149.<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Going to Fortress Vader on Mustafar===
Later, Krennic received a message to go meet with [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] at [[Fortress Vader]] on [[Mustafar]]. Krennic traveled there in the shuttle. After his meeting with Vader, the director ordered a course set for [[Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Scarif===
Krennic arrived on Scarif in the shuttle, though Captain Pterro remained aboard the Death Star and did not accompany Krennic or the shuttle to Scarif. During the Battle of Scarif, when the rebels attacked the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial Security Complex]] to steal the [[Death Star plans]], ST 149 remained parked on the executive landing pad for the entire battle. At the end of the battle, the Death Star destroyed the [[Citadel Tower]] under [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s orders, killing Krennic in the process.<ref name="Rogue One" />
